confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on partial 2025-2026 price signals (national flat white averages and a Byron Bay bar menu dated December 2025, plus a general budget guide of undated age), so they are bounded estimates. Beer and wine are weakly sourced: beer is inferred from the bar menu and wine is estimated from the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Byron Bay's regional tourism market in July (a peak winter and school-holiday period); no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Uncertainty is widest for hotel_3star_2p and hostel_private_2p.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is regional New South Wales coastal tourism: food and drink priced between Australian capital-city averages and premium beach-town venues, and accommodation priced for a high-demand coastal resort town in winter school holidays.
